protocol.representation: cached frozen eval-mode ResNet-18 features; no augmentation
protocol.objective: uniform client mean; FedAvg is client-uniform, not sample-weighted
protocol.head: shared random frozen 100-class linear base plus trainable LoRA; common initialization per seed
protocol.optimizer: Adam reset every round for every method, including local; paired client minibatch RNGs
protocol.personalized_accuracy: arithmetic mean of client adapter accuracy on disjoint client test shards
protocol.personalized_sample_weighted_accuracy: total correct across client test shards / total samples
protocol.consensus_accuracy: uniform mean effective adapter, SVD at consensus_rank, on union of test shards
protocol.oracle: known CIFAR superclass domain labels; no learned discovery or transfer weights
protocol.flat_topology: seeded permutation of client IDs independent of domain, matrix reordered to client order
protocol.local: no communication and no SVD reparameterization between local rounds
protocol.communication: simulated scalar float counts; multiply by 4 for fp32 bytes; excludes setup/evaluation
protocol.operational_transport: MH factors; FedAvg factors up/dense delta down; hierarchy factors first/dense later
protocol.factor_baseline: naive zero-padded factor averaging; merge error is not SVD tail mass
protocol.adaptive_rank: loss-adaptive capacity policy: two-round warmup, then half-ceiling for clients below 95% of the previous round median loss; rank changes preserve effective Delta-W
protocol.domain_weighting: bounded update-norm factors (blend 0.10, deviation bound 0.15) applied through symmetric Sinkhorn reweighting of the gossip matrix

feature_cache.representation: frozen ResNet-18, fc replaced by Identity, eval mode
